correctness.rationale: Primitive component area adds 2k-1 exactly. Formal differentiations of G(z,q,u) yield the displayed q, u and mixed series; extracting coefficients gives the covariance with all factors and denominators valid for n>=1. Monotone K_n starts at one and strictly increases for every n>=1, proving global negativity n>=2. The two variance identities follow from second derivatives, and Catalan Stirling asymptotics yield linear covariance and order n^-1/2 correlation. Exact raw moments independently match all 82,499 Dyck paths of semilength at most eleven and coefficient formulas through 150; finite checks supplement the analytic proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The prior Catalan functional equations dominate the generating-function setup: adding the prime-count marker is an elementary consequence, and the present claim does not assert it is new. Nonetheless extracting mixed coefficients, establishing a strict sign at every finite n by a nontrivial monotone Catalan ratio, and determining the anomalously small correlation are not explicitly covered by these inspected materials. Implicit recovery from broad prior formulas remains a genuine priority risk.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A theorem about either marginal alone does not imply the sign of their joint covariance. The joint series is easily recovered by combining the known prime decomposition with q-Catalan; thus the new theorem is limited to the exact mixed coefficient formula, strict negative all-size classification, and quantified correlation decay. The inspected sources do not assert these conclusions, but their general identities could be considered implicit computational coverage under a broad notion of prior implication.

originality.rationale: The precise object is area versus number of completed primitive factors, distinct from the classical Dyck area/rank or peak joint distributions. The existing area-refined prime-component functional relation (Petersen 2019) and existing marginal return law (Kobayashi et al. 2015) make joint marking immediate, which is not represented as novel. The inspected literature does not state the exact all-size mixed covariance with strictly negative sign and sharp vanishing-correlation coefficient. Originality is narrowly restricted to that result; implicit prior derivability and uninspected texts are real risks.
residual_risks: A broader published q-Catalan functional relation already implies the construction of the joint series. Another author may have published the exact covariance or its strict sign as an implicit corollary.
The entire 66-page Janson survey, full 24-page Blanco-Petersen article, and every historical Dyck statistic source were not exhaustively read.
Originality cannot be established from nonmatches; an expert literature audit and independent review have not occurred.

value.rationale: The area of a nonnegative excursion is a natural global workload statistic while its ground returns count primitive fragmentation. The exact global strict negative dependence has nontrivial quantitative content across all sizes, including an O(n) covariance despite O(n^{3/2}) area fluctuations and bounded return fluctuations. The exact coefficient of asymptotic decorrelation is not obtained from the pre-existing separate marginals or from a routine fixed-n example; all-size sign proof is structural and fully motivated.
